sheets.title: Bar opening duties
sheets.source: Erik, 9/28/26 ("Opening duties/checklist"), sent by Will. His wording and order; only a doubled space was removed. Replaces the 9/23 paper sheet (kept under superseded).

items.label: Punch in with your personal number
Grab 4 rags from storage room (two rags for both Sani-buckets and two extra)
Put garbage back in place & make sure they have bags in them. (1 can by left of bar, 2nd can by server well & 3rd at bar opening.
Lay down both rugs in their place (1 in front of server well & the other at bar opening)
Go to Kettle one Espresso machine & unwrap plastic off, set up & turn on. Also turn dial in between 6-7.
Turn on lights for both coolers. Located on inside of coolers along the wall of cooler.
Pull all insert tabs off of beer spouts & soak in soda water
Check to make sure all beer kegs are tapped & in stock in cooler
Turn on slushy machine and make sure it is full on both sides. If not full refill.
Take covers off ice well & fill them up. If the 2nd or 3rd wells will be in use be sure to fill those too.
If the dehydrator is out remove all fruit & store properly. Then put dehydrator back in mechanical room
Take out glass cleaner brushes from sink & be sure they are clean from debris from the bottom (such as mint leaves)
Attach them to glass cleaner machine
Clean & wipe down all 3 sink wells really well & clean glass cleaner machine as well
Fill 3rd sink with cold water then add 1/2 of red sani-clean packet, Fill middle sink with warm water & Fill 1st sink with hot water then add green glass cleaning packet.
Grab your 2 red Sani-Buckets take them to kitchen to fill them with hot hot water & 2 pumps of Red Sanitizer located under kitchen sink across from dish cleaning station
Add your rags to buckets & put one of each at each end of bar on floor
Then wipe your bar down & set out specials tents
Start to set up your bar for the day pull all liquor bottle tabs off & store in cup with soda water.
Make sure all liquor wells are stocked
Set up your bar the juices, utensils, & fruit
Make sure there is a back up for 2nd well & possibly a 3rd if you know it’s going to be busy.
Set up 2nd well juices in cooler in metal tin & set up fruit for 2nd well wrapped in plastic & leave on bar cart in cooler ready for later
Make sure the fruit container back ups are full
Make sure all back up drink mixes are made
Check refrigerator in kitchen there are back ups
Set up expo station for flow
Check tables, booths and floors for debris
Make sure host stand is clean and organized
Make sure server station and handhelds have receipt paper and check books
Fill sani bucket and get clean cloths
Put napkins/utensil setups on app plates

sheets.title: Server end of morning shift (before clocking out)

items.label: Stock anything that's low from previous shift
Stock straws, coasters, cups, to-gos, napkins
If tea is half full: dump into container with the date & bring to dish
Bring dirty food trays to dish
Bring old sani buckets to dish
Bring ketchup pump to dish, wrap 2oz ketchup cups & tin, then bring to walk-in
Break down soda machine & bring ice scooper to dish
Check storage room for any trash, food, or drinks
Check the line for any leftover drinks
Review prep list and complete all required prep
Fill deli containers with backups needed for the day (juice, syrups, garnishes)
Stock additional backup bottles as needed
Set out juices at all required stations
Remove all bottle covers from wells
Remove and set out beer brushes
Check dehydrator and empty if needed
